subject.title: Feature request: cron job auto-retry on failure (--retry-count, --retry-delay)

question: Should OpenClaw add per-job cron retry fields and `openclaw cron add/edit` retry flags, or keep retry policy global under `cron.retry` for now?
rationale: The remaining work changes public CLI/API and persisted job semantics, and repository policy treats new config/default surfaces as maintainer-owned product direction before implementation.

options.title: Sponsor narrow per-job retry
options.body: Approve additive per-job retry metadata and CLI flags, then review or replace the stale fork implementation with focused compatibility and cadence tests.

options.title: Keep global retry only
options.body: Close or defer this request and rely on `cron.retry` plus the reason-aware guardrail issue for future retry policy work.

options.title: Wait for reason-aware policy first
options.body: Leave this issue blocked on the broader guardrail design so per-job controls are shaped around failure categories and circuit-breaker behavior.

recommendation.title: Sponsor narrow per-job retry
recommendation.body: Approve additive per-job retry metadata and CLI flags, then review or replace the stale fork implementation with focused compatibility and cadence tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest current-main cron retry behavior and regression coverage landed through steipete's merged PR, making them the best available routing owner for this product-contract decision.
